LanguageData.Botania.GaiaShardFall.Label: Gaia shard falls
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaShardFall.Text: A slab of living crystal punched through the sky and buried itself in the ground near your colony. It vibrates, and the rhythm is like a heartbeat.\n\nBreak it open, and whatever is on the other side will have a way through.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalOpened.Label: Gaia portal opens
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalOpened.Text:
The shard cracked apart without debris, leaving a ring of green light standing upright. Something is already queuing to come through.

The portal cannot be harmed. Hold out for three waves, or press Stop the ritual and give the attempt up.
(The boss itself is not implemented yet; clearing the waves leaves the portal open.)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaWave.Message: Wave {0} / {1}: {2} enemies pour out of the Gaia portal
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalReady.Label: Gaia portal is open
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalReady.Text: All three waves are gone, and the green light inside the portal has thickened into something solid.\n\n(The boss itself is not implemented yet.)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSurrender.Label: Stop the ritual (surrender)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSurrender.Desc: Turn the enemies on the field back into light and pull them into the portal, ending this attempt. Nothing counts as a kill and nothing drops;\nthe portal goes dark for a day, after which the event can be triggered again.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSurrenderDone.Label: Gaia ritual stopped
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSurrenderDone.Text: The portal drew the last of the light back in and went dark.\n\nIt will light again - in a day.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalActivated.Label: Gaia portal activated
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalActivated.Text: The green light inside the portal flipped over the moment the survey finished, from still to flowing.\n\nSomething is already pushing at the other side.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInvestigate.Label: Send someone to investigate
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInvestigate.Desc:
Pick a colonist and assign them the Investigate Gaia Portal job.

This is a **research-type job**: they walk over, stand at the portal and advance the investigation at their research speed; leaving stops it.
(Raising the Research work priority lets colonists come on their own.) Waves start only once the investigation is complete.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInvestigate.NoPawn: No colonist is free to investigate (busy, downed or in a mental state)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInspect.Dormant: Awaiting investigation: a colonist must stand inside it ({0}%), auto-investigate {1}
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInspect.Dimmed: Dimmed; can be investigated again in {0}
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInvestigate.Ordered: {0} has been sent to investigate the Gaia portal
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalAppeared.Label: A Gaia portal has appeared
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaPortalAppeared.Text:
The shard cracked apart without debris, leaving a ring of green light standing upright. It is still - but it feels like it is waiting for someone.

Send a colonist over to **investigate** it. Nothing can come through until the survey is finished.
(Raising the Research work priority lets colonists come on their own.)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaInvestigate.NoCell: There is no walkable cell next to the portal
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaAuto.Label: Auto investigate
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaAuto.Desc: When on, colonists come to investigate according to their Research work priority. When off, only the colonist you pick with Send someone to investigate will come.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaAuto.OnMsg: Auto investigate: on (colonists come by research priority)
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaBossShieldBroken.Label: The Gaia shield shatters
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaBossShieldBroken.Text: The moment the shield breaks, the world-soul locks up. Hit it now.\n\nThe shield will re-form in 20 seconds.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaBossPhase.Label: Gaia transforms (phase {0})
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaBossPhase.Text: It has locked its wounds inside itself and is shedding a layer of shell.\n\nIt cannot be hurt for 5 seconds, and the shield re-forms.

LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillEarthWrath.Label: Earth wrath
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillEarthWrath.Desc: A 60-degree cone (radius 6) in front. After a 2-second warning it deals 60 blunt damage and knocks targets back 3 cells. 4s cooldown.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillEntangle.Label: Entangling roots
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillEntangle.Desc: Pins 1-2 targets for 3 seconds, dealing 2 natural damage every 2 seconds (legs first). 6s cooldown.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillManaBeam.Label: Mana beam
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillManaBeam.Desc: Locks the farthest target, charges for 5 seconds, then deals 40 heat damage and ignites everything along the line. 5s cooldown.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillSummon.Desc: Summons 3 Gaia seeds (war urchins for now). Once in phase II and once in phase III.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaWorldSoulStart.Label: World-soul
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaWorldSoulStart.Desc: Charges for 20 seconds (fully invulnerable), then a red shockwave expands outward for 50 cells. Walls block it completely. Once per fight.
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaSkillSummon.Label: Summon Gaia seeds
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaBossCannotRecruit: Gaia cannot be controlled; it turns hostile again
LanguageData.Botania.GaiaWorldSoulStart.Text:
In 20 seconds it will sweep the whole area in a single burst.

Red cells will be hit; green cells are blocked by walls and completely safe.
Walls built during the charge take effect immediately.
